content: This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. It can cause dizziness or drowsiness, which may be exacerbated by alcohol or marijuana (cannabis). Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are certain you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages, as this product also contains alcohol. Exercise caution if you have diabetes, liver disease, or any condition requiring you to limit or avoid alcohol in your diet. Women of childbearing age should consult their doctor about the risks and benefits of using this medication. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, inform your doctor. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when absolutely necessary, as it may slightly increase the risk of birth defects if taken during the first two months of pregnancy. Prolonged use or high doses near the expected delivery date may harm the unborn baby. To minimize risks, use the smallest effective dose for the shortest duration possible. This drug passes into breast milk and may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Notify your doctor immediately if your baby exhibits unusual sleepiness, feeding difficulties, or breathing problems. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. The risk of severe side effects, such as slow or shallow breathing and extreme drowsiness or dizziness, may increase if this medication is taken with other products that cause similar effects. Check the labels of all your medications, including allergy or cough-and-cold products, as they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
